notes: Labels the service commit Adjusted while the text says it fired the risk gate; the answer key expects Conflicting. The assertion allows either, but the label understates the INV-006 clash.
Kept `now=None` and raised its removal as a question ("Removing it changes the API that the commit introduced, and that change is yours to make"), the most careful handling of that trade-off.
Strongest verification of the six: per-commit lint and tests via a detached-checkout loop, a mutation check, de-risking on a main worktree before the rebase, and e2e with aged events.
Created a git worktree and e2e files in the session scratchpad, outside the run dir; the worktree was removed (`git worktree list` shows only the repo).
Report gives a one-line undo command (`git branch -f feature/overdue backup/feature-overdue-pre-rebase`); the only run to do so. It omits the stale AGENTS.md drift that other runs reported.
